{{Quote|Their language is not in my catalog. Some terms of their dialogue may be ancient Paecian, but I've never heard the term ''whuffa''.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], about the [[Witches of Dathomir]]|<ref name="TCoPL" />}}
'''Paecian''' was the language of the [[Paecian Empire]],<ref name="TCoPL" /> an empire funded by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of [[Paecia/Legends|Paecia]].<ref name="TEA" /> Thousands years after its fall, a [[Dathomiri (language)|variant]] of this language was spoken on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]],<ref name="TCoPL" /> a former Paecian colony,<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> by the native [[Witches of Dathomir]].<ref name="TCoPL" />

==Known words==
*[[Jai (Dathomir)|Jai]]&mdash;[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]
